*[[ASUS GT-BE19000]] • [[ASUS ROG Rapture GT-BE19000]] • [[ASUS GT-BE96]] :Tri-band Wi-Fi 7 Router, 802.11be: 2.4GHz 4x4 + 5GHz 4x4 + 6GHz 4x4, 2x 10G :Gaming features: Mobile game mode, ASUS features: AiMesh, AiProtection
===Specifications=== :• Processor: 2.6GHz quad-core processor :• Memory: 256 MB Flash and 2 GB RAM :• Product Segment: BE19000: 1376+5765+11530 Mbps :• Transmit/Receive: 2.4GHz 4x4, 5GHz 4x4, 6GHz 4x4 :• Data Rate: ::WiFi 7 (802.11be) (2.4GHz): up to 1376 Mbps ::WiFi 7 (802.11be) (5GHz): up to 5765 Mbps ::WiFi 7 (802.11be) (6GHz): up to 11530 Mbps ::Antenna: External antenna x8 :• Ports: ::1x 10Gbps for WAN/LAN, 1x 10Gbps for LAN ::1x 2.5Gbps for WAN/LAN, 3x 2.5Gbps for LAN ::1x GbE for LAN, 1x USB 3.2 (Gen 1), 1x USB 2.0
